The repair resolves the earlier scope objection: this is explicitly library groundwork, with caller wiring tracked separately, and the diff is limited to redisq plus focused tests. Two helper contracts still overstate what they report. `FencedAck` returns true whenever the token matches, even when Redis `XACK` returns 0, although its comment says true means the ack was made; return the XACK count (or rename/document the result as authorization) and add a valid-lease/non-pending-ID case. `DirQueue.ModeRestart` ignores `fmt.Fprintf` errors and can report that restart may start without recording the promised drain line; propagate the write error and test with a failing writer.

Validation: exact-head source review and `git diff --check` passed; I did not run Go tests or inspect CI.
